newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse ends week 0.14 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse ends week 0.14 pct higher.

text.p: Morocco's stock exchange ended the week on Friday 0.14 percent higher, lifted mainly by largest capitalisation firms including ONA Group, brokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 651.39 points from 650.49 at the previous session.
"Business on the bourse was marked by active trading in blue-chip firms which gained up to 10 dirhams," a Casablanca-based trader said.
ONA, the country's largest private conglomerate, rose five dirhams to close at 820.
The group has three other subsidiaries listed on the market including sugar refinery Cosumar which remained stable at 880 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second private conglomerate which controls interests in more than 40 companies, gained five dirhams to close at 755.
In the banking sector Wafabank jumped nine dirhams to end the session at 846.
Morocco's main oil refinery Samir moved up slightly to 339.15 dirhams compared with 339.10 on Thursday.
Ciments de l'Oriental, a large cement firm, rose 10 dirhams to close at 695.
Trading volume reached 51.5 million dirhams of which 20.5 million was on the official market, a stockbroker said. ($1= 9.9 dirhams)
